description: Department of Local Government Eastern Province - Notice on Summon Meeting on 07.03.2019 at Addalachchenai Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the summoning of a meeting to fill a vacancy in a local authority (Addalachenai Pradeshiya Sabha) caused by a resignation, under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. The content is directly related to the electoral process and administration of a local government body, making it a clear fit for the Elections category (Type 7).
